steps.text: Capture measurements: a hands-free phone scan, two photos, a quick estimate, or your tailor's numbers.
Choose a base style → tweak options (neck, sleeve, length, closures, trims).
Select fabric & accessories → pricing auto-updates with yardage & options.
Tailors quote with a timeline → you pick one and pay a deposit → production steps tracked.
Photos of the finished piece → pay the balance → delivery, with support if anything is wrong.
